# B20 final qualification registration (after source freeze)

Implementation aff93db2ff199488d191b0e32584f9a4c4a0cbbd contains only the
rooted formatter discovery correction, existing ignore dependency edge and
focused regressions. Temporary instrumentation is removed. The diagnostic
chained-link flag is NOT production; canonical Cargo invocation rebuilds the
compiler without it. No further implementation edits are planned before tests.
The candidate's forthcoming phase progress record is docs only; record exact
final candidate SHA with executed commands. All predecessor files stay read-only.

Run only named tests, in this order:
1. python3 verification/areas/performance/run_benchmarks.py --self-test
2. python3 verification/areas/performance/check_budgets.py --self-test
3. cargo test --locked -p sifr --bin sifr formatter_discovery
4. cargo test --locked -p sifr --test formatter_discovery
5. cargo fmt --check
6. python3 scripts/check_hir_maintainability_guardrails.py
7. git diff --check (also base-to-candidate diff check).
8. Enclosing representative benchmark-subset and dependent budget-subset,
   using runner.run_profile_variants('representative') exactly. The external
   driver records returned variant argv/status/raw stdout/stderr and preserves
   the canonical runner's result/command-evidence/rejected-attempt artifacts.
   Resolve its10case members verbatim from runner.REPRESENTATIVE_CASES and
   invoke once with manifest samples, --require-controlled-host,
   --controlled-host-mode work, unique invocation id. Do not invoke the six
   unrelated run_rules_variants checks or separately repeat the formatter case.
   If benchmark-subset fails, preserve canonical blocked budget-subset; do not
   run budget against stale/incomplete evidence. No unchanged replay.

crates/sifr_format has no final diff, so cargo test -p sifr_format is not
applicable. Instrumented builds were diagnosis only. No source/config/fixture,
workload, baseline, retry, limit or acceptance definition changes for qualification.
Wait for coordinator65 metadata-only window handback before execution. No
host-sensitive run concurrent with Cargo tests/build. One initial exact-SHA
Opus review only, at most one remediation; review full actual B20 acceptance,
not a claim that discovery alone cures startup variance. A failure blocks merge.
Compiler+lock edge changed: at most one merge-profile gate only after required
qualification and exact-SHA approval; skip create-pr gate, no second gate.

Current unresolved requirement: startup variation's corrective intervention
has not been established. 09 locates it before first initializer;11/14 identify
VM/hash/security work,12's link-format intervention reduces mean but retains
variation. No lower mean is a CV pass, and no unavailable intervention or
specific OS defect is proven. Qualification will not erase this limitation.
